title: Kinetic Serpent
game_overview: A modern arcade snake game steered through real-time body motion and relative turning, featuring hazard dodging and time-freeze shields.
winning_condition: Achieve high score records without time limit by surviving escalating hazard density and collecting energy cores.
losing_condition: Serpent collides with perimeter walls, its own body segments, or red kinetic hazard mines.

controls.input: Body Lean Left / Arrow Left Key / Virtual Left Button
controls.action: Rotate serpent 90 degrees counter-clockwise relative to its current movement heading.

controls.input: Body Lean Right / Arrow Right Key / Virtual Right Button
controls.action: Rotate serpent 90 degrees clockwise relative to its current movement heading.

controls.input: Arms Parallel (Shield Freeze) / Spacebar / Virtual Shield Button
controls.action: Trigger emergency brake: serpent stops in place for 3 seconds while activating an invulnerable energy shield (consumes 1 brake charge).
Maintain forward movement heading without changing orientation.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Embodied Immersion: Translating physical upper-body posture directly into high-stakes arcade maneuvers. 2. Relative Steering Precision: Maintaining classic arcade turning simplicity anchored to the serpent's perspective. 3. Clutch Tactical Brakes: Limited-use 3-second freeze barriers turning claustrophobic grid traps into breather windows.
sections.summary: Core pillars focusing on somatic intuition, twitch arcade reflex, and strategic emergency pacing.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: The serpent glides forward continuously at steady tick intervals. Players physically lean left or right to command 90-degree relative turns. Consuming green energy orbs rewards +10 points and elongates the tail, while dynamically spawning static red hazard mines. When boxed into corners, players trigger Shield Freeze to halt for 3 seconds, surveying the grid. Game over triggers upon perimeter wall crash, self-tail collision, or mine impact.
sections.summary: Navigate grid, collect energy cores, evade lethal hazards, and trigger emergency freeze buffers.

sections.title: Movement & Scrolling Alignment
sections.content: Scrolling Axis: None (Bounded Arena on a high-visibility 24x24 logical grid). Asset Orientation Baseline: True 90-degree orthogonal overhead view, with serpent head facing its instant vector (0, 90, 180, 270 degrees). Movement Physics Dynamics: Discrete grid advancement on fixed tick timer (accelerating every 5 energy orbs eaten). Camera Behavior: Static locked camera spanning the entirety of the primary canvas.
sections.summary: Bounded 2D orthogonal grid arena with 4-directional relative steering.

sections.title: Teachable Machine Pose Integration & Anti-Jitter
sections.content: Layout splits into Left (Arcade Canvas) and Right (Webcam Viewport and AI Diagnostics). Loads @tensorflow/tfjs and @teachablemachine/pose from CDN. Prediction probability must exceed 0.85 to qualify as an active posture. Anti-jitter pipeline enforces a 3-consecutive-frame buffer for 'Lean_Left', 'Lean_Right', and 'Shield_Freeze' before dispatching the turn command, preventing false triggers from minor human involuntary sway.
sections.summary: Dual-column split layout with TensorFlow.js pose pipeline and 3-frame debounce threshold.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Layer Separation: Background uses dark deep-navy grid lines (#0a0f1d) with zero collision distractions. Playfield features radiant electric-cyan serpent (#00f0ff), vivid lime-emerald energy food (#00ff88), and high-contrast pulsating crimson hazard mines (#ff0055). HUD Overlay: Top bar displays Current Score, High Score record, and glowing Shield Brake counters outside the playfield zone.
sections.summary: High-contrast cyberpunk neon palette prioritizing hazard readability.

sections.title: Fairness Tools & Hazards
sections.content: Hazard mines spawn with a 1-second translucent warning flicker before solidifying into lethal geometry, ensuring players are never instantly eliminated by an unfair instant spawn on top of their trajectory. Emergency brakes display a radial 3-second countdown gauge.
sections.summary: Clear warning cues and predictable brake mechanics.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Input Juice: Visual direction arrows briefly flash beneath the serpent head upon executing a valid turn. State Change Juice: Chromatic trail particles emit behind tail nodes; energy shield projects a rotating hexagonal aura during brake freeze. Impact Juice: Screen shake on hazard collision with CRT static flash on Game Over.
sections.summary: Multi-tier sensory feedback for turns, eating, and collisions.

sections.title: Social Mechanics & Audience
sections.content: Built for arcade gamers, tech demo enthusiasts, and casual players seeking hands-free, body-driven fitness gameplay. Features persistent localStorage High Score tracking.
sections.summary: Competitive local high score chasing and interactive webcam novelty.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: Seamless fallback to Arrow Left / Arrow Right / Spacebar controls allows instantaneous gameplay testing without requiring a webcam or TensorFlow model load. Status pill indicators show AI connection health, webcam frame rate, and active detected gesture.
sections.summary: Full dual-input redundancy and visual indicators.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Finite state machine with states: MENU, PLAYING, FROZEN_BRAKE, and GAME_OVER. Game Over overlay provides immediate summary score, best score badge, and an instant Restart trigger via button or Spacebar.
sections.summary: State machine managing title, active play, freeze pause, and game over screens.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Conditional mobile touch controls render responsive Left Turn, Right Turn, and Shield Brake buttons in the viewport lower corners. Wired with onPointerDown, onPointerUp, onPointerLeave, touch-none CSS, and pointer-events-auto on action buttons.
sections.summary: Conditional touch buttons for mobile testing.
